name: Digital Shield
body:
School abjuration; Level technomancer 2

CASTING

Casting Time ? 1 immediate action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

When you take damage from an effect, you can create a defensive conduit between yourself and one synthetic or technological weapon, armor, or other item you’re carrying or wearing that’s no heavier than 20 lbs. The chosen object takes damage equal to 1d6 times your caster level, ignoring the object’s hardness. You reduce the damage you take from the triggering attack by half this amount.
